about: The skill tree: five branches, one per exam domain. Each branch has 4 tiers. A tier opens once you have spent tierCosts[tier - 1] points anywhere in the tree. Small nodes take up to 3 points, notables 1, keystones 1 (and you can only have one keystone). stats are added per point. Stat names: damage (% skill damage), hp (max health), time (seconds per question), heal (health per correct answer), weakness (extra weak-point multiplier), dodge (% less enemy hit chance), defense (% less damage taken), xp (% more XP), loot (% more gear drop chance), domainDamage (% damage with this branch's domain skills). Keystone rules are written in js/skilltree.js and their numbers are in js/config.js.

nodes.name: Confidentiality
nodes.concept: Confidentiality: only people with permission can read the data.

nodes.name: Integrity
nodes.concept: Integrity: data can't be changed without someone noticing. Hashes help prove it.

nodes.name: Availability
nodes.concept: Availability: systems and data are there when authorized users need them.

nodes.name: Non-repudiation
nodes.concept: Non-repudiation: a digital signature proves who sent something, so they can't deny it later.

nodes.name: Gap Analysis
nodes.concept: Gap analysis: comparing where your security is now with where it needs to be.

nodes.name: Zero Trust
nodes.text: Weak points take +0.5x more damage. Every other hit deals 40% less.
nodes.concept: Zero trust: never trust by default. Verify every request, every time.

nodes.name: Threat Intel
nodes.text: Enemies hit 2% less often per point
nodes.concept: Threat intelligence: what is known about attackers and their methods, used to get ready before they strike.

nodes.name: Vulnerability Scanning
nodes.concept: Vulnerability scanning: automatically checking systems for known weaknesses.

nodes.name: Hardening
nodes.concept: Hardening: turning off unneeded services, ports and accounts to shrink the attack surface.

nodes.name: Indicators of Compromise
nodes.text: +15% damage with Domain 2 skills (The Breach Wastes)
nodes.concept: Indicators of compromise: clues that an attack happened, like odd logins, strange traffic or changed files.

nodes.name: Mitigation
nodes.concept: Mitigation: patching, isolation and least privilege make an attack less likely to work, or less harmful if it does.

nodes.name: Assume Breach
nodes.text: Start every fight at 70% health, but deal 30% more damage.
nodes.concept: Assume breach: plan as if attackers are already inside, so you're ready to find and remove them.

nodes.name: Segmentation
nodes.concept: Segmentation: splitting a network into zones so one breach can't spread everywhere.

nodes.name: Redundancy
nodes.concept: Redundancy: spare power, disks or servers, so one failure doesn't take everything down.

nodes.name: Load Balancing
nodes.concept: Load balancing: spreading traffic across several servers so none of them is overwhelmed.

nodes.name: Infrastructure as Code
nodes.concept: Infrastructure as code: building systems from scripts, so every build is the same and easy to review.

nodes.name: Hot Site
nodes.concept: Hot site: a backup location that is already running and can take over almost at once.

nodes.name: Defense in Depth
nodes.text: Take 30% less damage, but deal 15% less.
nodes.concept: Defense in depth: layers of controls, so if one fails another still stops the attack.

nodes.name: Log Review
nodes.text: Heal 1 health per correct answer, per point
nodes.concept: Log review: reading system and security logs to work out what happened and when.

nodes.name: Alert Tuning
nodes.concept: Alert tuning: adjusting alerts to cut false positives, so real threats stand out.

nodes.name: Automation
nodes.concept: Automation and orchestration: scripts and playbooks that respond faster than people can.

nodes.name: Incident Response
nodes.text: +15% damage with Domain 4 skills (The Operations Deep)
nodes.concept: Incident response: preparation, detection, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, lessons learned.

nodes.name: EDR
nodes.concept: EDR (endpoint detection and response): watches devices for suspicious behavior and can stop an attack in progress.

nodes.name: Rapid Response
nodes.text: Answer within 20 seconds for +40% damage. Slower answers deal 20% less.
nodes.concept: Time to respond: the faster a team reacts to an incident, the less damage it does.

nodes.name: Awareness Training
nodes.concept: Security awareness training: teaching people to spot phishing and report problems.

nodes.name: Due Care
nodes.concept: Due care: doing what a reasonable organization would do to protect its people and data.

nodes.name: Vendor Assessment
nodes.text: +3% chance for gear to drop, per point
nodes.concept: Vendor assessment: checking a supplier's security before trusting them with your data.

nodes.name: Governance
nodes.text: +15% damage with Domain 5 skills (The Council Spire)
nodes.concept: Governance: the policies, standards and roles that steer how security is run.

nodes.name: Business Impact Analysis
nodes.text: +5% skill damage and take 5% less damage
nodes.concept: Business impact analysis: working out which systems matter most and how long you can go without them.

nodes.name: Accept the Risk
nodes.text: +40% XP and +15% gear drop chance, but enemies hit 10% more often.
nodes.concept: Risk acceptance: knowingly living with a risk because fixing it would cost more than it's worth.
